findings.issue: Meson-free material in a meson home. Every declaration except `chargeRadiusSq_singlePole_piPlus` (line 408) is stated for an abstract `V` with a `Bilin` form and two momenta and mentions no meson: `IsElasticStabilizer`, `IsCovariant` and its lemmas (`isCovariant_iff`, `isCovariant_smul_add_smul`, `isCovariant_smul_add_add_smul_sub`, `reflect_isElasticStabilizer`, `IsCovariant.apply_eq_zero`, `.exists_eq_smul_add_smul`, `.exists_eq_smul_add_add_smul_sub`, `.existsUnique_eq_smul`), `ElasticSpectatorAssumptions`, `apply_sub_smul_add_smul`, `coeff_sub_eq_zero_of_apply_sub_eq_zero`, `apply_sub_smul_add_eq_zero`, the whole witness block (`pWit`, `pWit'`, `gWit_pWit_self_eq`, `gWit_sub_pWit`, `elasticSpectatorAssumptions_pWit`, `isCovariant_pWit'_sub_pWit`, `gWit_sub_pWit_spectator_eq_zero`, `not_isCovariant_spectator`), `HasFormFactor` with `hasFormFactor_iff`/`hasFormFactor_smul_add`/`isCovariant`/`apply_sub_eq_zero`/`apply_eq_of_hasFormFactor`/`apply_zero_eq`, `chargeRadiusSq`(+`_def`,`_eq`), and `singlePole`(+`_def`,`_zero`, `hasDerivAt_singlePole`, `chargeRadiusSq_singlePole`, `tendsto_mul_singlePole_atBot`). They are named `EpsilonEridani.Particles.Meson.FormFactor.*`, so any other spin-zero target (e.g. the spin-zero nuclei of `Particles/Nuclei/Light/`) must import meson data and call meson-namespaced lemmas to use them.

summary: The module is almost entirely hadron-generic: only chargeRadiusSq_singlePole_piPlus (line 408) uses meson data, yet the whole elastic-covariance, HasFormFactor, charge-radius and single-pole apparatus sits in the Particles/Meson namespace. Imports are fine.
